name: data-skill
description: Make product and business data trustworthy, governed, usable

interface.shortDescription: Make product and business data trustworthy, governed, usable
interface.longDescription: Faceted-router skill for the analytical, governed data plane: event tracking and tracking plans, data contracts and schema evolution, ingestion/CDC, transformation and modeling, metrics/semantic layer and BI, data quality and testing, lineage, governance/PII/retention, experiment measurement validity, and platform/cost decisions — vendor-neutral, decision-first, with date-stamped volatile facts and license-aware tool picks.
defaultPrompt: Use $data to design a tracking plan and data contract for our product events, with quality checks.
